entity_keys.country: ISO3; sovereign status and territory metadata must be explicit
entity_keys.organisation: IATI reporting-org ref; do not equate organisation with nation
entity_keys.pair: donor ISO3 + recipient ISO3 + DAC sector + observation period

financial_rules: Keep transaction types 2 commitment, 3 disbursement, 4 expenditure separate
Keep currency and value-date; no mixed-currency sum
Use transaction-level country/sector where present; otherwise declared activity allocations
Do not divide equally when published shares are missing; mark unallocated
Do not sum IATI, CRS and Lowy as independent money
IATI identifier count is activity count, not necessarily unique development project count
Resolve parent-child and cofunding overlaps before portfolio totals

colors.country: separate donor/recipient legend; no grade for missing
colors.chemistry: shared fixed scale only for comparable observed scores; red/blue does not encode missing
colors.missing: hatched/light grey with reason; allow click for available records

role_selection: Either donor-first or recipient-first; a country may have both roles; multilaterals in separate entity layer
publication_policy: Do not show experimental grades as externally validated rankings; predictions require separate validation and visual label
